hook: If you stood on Enceladus, ice would spray into space beside you.
title: Saturn's Moon Sprays Ice Into Space
description:
Saturn's moon Enceladus shoots water ice into space from cracks at its south pole. NASA's Cassini spacecraft flew through the plumes and photographed them. Series: If You Were in Space.

#Shorts #Space #Saturn
comment_prompt: Is there life there? Yes or no

scenes.narration: If you stood on Enceladus, ice would spray into space beside you.
scenes.headline: ICE SPRAYS INTO SPACE

scenes.narration: The jets burst from cracks at its south pole.
scenes.headline: SOUTH POLE CRACKS

scenes.narration: Water erupts and freezes into tiny ice grains.
scenes.headline: WATER TO ICE

scenes.narration: NASA's Cassini flew straight through the plumes.
scenes.headline: CASSINI FLEW THROUGH

scenes.narration: It photographed the jets spraying outward.
scenes.headline: PHOTOGRAPHED LIVE

scenes.narration: The water appears to come from an ocean below.
scenes.headline: OCEAN UNDER ICE

scenes.narration: That spray is real water from another world.
scenes.headline: ANOTHER WORLD

scenes.narration: Ice really sprays into space from Enceladus.
scenes.headline: IT'S REAL

scenes.narration: Tomorrow: a man flying with jet engines.
scenes.headline: TOMORROW
